lines.t: Yeah… darkness overhead,
But the call still echoes—
Kiss The Son.
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son,
Bow before the Holy One,
When the sky turns black and the storm has come,
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son.
Mercy for the weary one,
When the world shakes loud, don’t run—
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son.
Great turmoil rising, generations crying,
Hearts getting heavy, truth keeps flying,
No place to hide when the heavens open,
Ancient words spoken, judgment awoken.
Turn from the noise, turn from the pride,
Lay down the rebellion, come to His side,
Not a crown of gold, not a throne of fame—
Just a humble heart calling His name.
When the thunder rolls…
When the night is long…
There’s a refuge, there’s a place to belong,
Not by force, not by fear—
But love drawing near.
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son,
Bow before the Holy One,
When the sky turns black and the storm has come,
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son.
Mercy for the weary one,
When the world shakes loud, don’t run—
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son.
They chase the flash, they chase the crown,
But everything built up is coming down,
Power fades, empires fall,
But love remains through it all.
No mask, no game, no hiding place,
Just open hands and amazing grace,
The King is near, so near, so real—
Not a distant God, but one who heals.
Rest upon the bosom, peace like a river,
Even in the fire, faith won’t shiver,
Judgment and justice, mercy and truth—
The invitation is for you...
Kiss The Son…
Kiss The Son…
Before the day is done…
Kiss The Son…
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son,
Bow before the Holy One,
When the sky turns black and the storm has come,
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son.
Mercy for the weary one,
When the world shakes loud, don’t run—
Kiss The Son, kiss The Son.
Not fear… just love.
Not chaos… just refuge.
Kiss The Son.
